header_sub: Richer shapes + host view. Drag any box to move it, drag the background to pan, scroll / pinch buttons to zoom, click a box for its details. Dragging explores the view — it does not change the canonical source (docs/architecture.md in this repo). Demo only: Emma / Noah.
panel_body: The demo's pieces, drawn by type and placed where they run. The Card Page is a screen, the Gate is a server, the Generator and Minter are local Python workers, and the JSON files are cylinders. Click any box for its job. Everything here is invented sample content — the demo connects to no account or service.
footer_note: This page is the interactive rendering of the diagram in docs/architecture.md (same folder) — the Mermaid source there is the source of truth, and this rendering is generated from the same model. In the demo the note box is disabled and its endpoint is a stub that discards; there is no notes inbox and nothing is forwarded anywhere.

cloudflare.title: Cloudflare Pages
cloudflare.sub: Edge hosting — the gated site lives here

google.title: Sample data
google.sub: Bundled invented files — no external services

kid.title: Emma / Noah
kid.body: Each kid reads only their own card. Access is by a coded link, not an account. (The note box on the card is decorative in the demo.)

owner.title: Dad
owner.body: Reads both cards with tabs, and mints the demo access codes (via the Minter).

parent.title: Parent viewer
parent.body: Reads both cards, logistics only, with a parent-scoped code.

repo.title: Family Cards Demo Repo
repo.body: Canonical source: page, gate, generator, sample data, and the architecture diagram — plus the generated card data.

page.title: Card Page
page.body: The only thing a reader ever sees. Renders one kid card, or both with tabs for owner / parent. Shows Big and CHANGED tags and the (disabled) notes box. It renders static JSON only — it never calls any API.

gate.title: Gate Middleware
gate.body: Checks every request: redeems a code against stored hashes, sets a signed scoped cookie, enforces scope per file, answers the scope check, and handles the note endpoint. Fails closed.

carddata.title: Per-kid Card Data
carddata.body: emma.json and noah.json — one file per kid: two-week window, With Dad / With Mom days, entries, legs, CHANGED tags, and that kid's own notes only.

codes.title: Access Code Hashes
codes.body: codes.json holds SHA-256 hashes and expiries only. Plain demo codes are never stored in the repo.

gen.title: Card Generator
gen.body: The engine of the demo. Reads the bundled sample events, drops the sensitive sample entries, frames With Dad / With Mom, resolves drivers, applies Big and CHANGED, and writes the per-kid JSON.

minter.title: Code Minter
minter.body: Mints random per-scope expiring demo codes in batches. Only the hashes are committed to the repo.

watch.title: Card Snapshots
watch.body: The previous run's cards, kept in a local snapshots folder. The next generator run diffs against them to decide CHANGED tags and the Last changed stamp. Nothing is scheduled in the demo — you re-run the generator by hand.

snap.title: Build Report
snap.body: A per-run JSON report of how each pickup / drop-off leg was decided (which rule won), written next to the snapshots. A development aid for working on the demo.

cal.title: Sample Events
cal.body: sample_events.json — the invented events the generator practices on, grouped into three sample calendars. The demo has no calendar connection and reads no account; this file is the generator's only input.

form.title: Sample Notes
form.body: A few invented notes baked into the sample card files so the design can show how notes would look on a card. The note box itself is disabled in the demo; nothing is collected or sent.
